updateRule: Only owner explicitly approves design; 'proceed' authorizes planning, not all proposals. Versions supersede, never silently overwrite decisions.

entries.decision: Original creature-collecting RPG WILDSIGNAL working title
entries.notes: Title clearance must be checked before branding commercial release

entries.decision: Visual tone beautiful but mysterious: cute creatures, lush nature and ancient mysterious ruins
entries.notes: Esthetic reference not a source asset license

entries.decision: Primary first-person retro 2.5D pixel-art perspective; 2D-authored world preferred
entries.notes: Exact renderer, pitch/height and optional third-person are unapproved

entries.decision: C++ with lightweight libraries, without Unity/Unreal/Godot as development dependency
entries.notes: SDL3 and exact library stack only proposed

entries.decision: Windows PC release planned via Steam and Android release planned via Google Play
entries.notes: Actual store account/payment/review requirements remain future work

entries.decision: Entire story/creature-bonding and PvE adventure playable offline; multiplayer is optional online add-on
entries.notes: Offline experience not dependent on server
entries.evidence: User selected offline adventure + online multiplayer

entries.decision: Turn-based 1v1-oriented creature battles
entries.notes: Party count, combat formula, moves and Signal Energy not approved

entries.decision: Companions physically follow, react and assist exploration
entries.notes: Specific AI and animation states draft

entries.decision: Original hand-created 10x10 sprite sheet from user, owner authorizes game use
entries.notes: Retain asset ledger and original file; no generic AI replacement
entries.evidence: User corrected provenance and asserted ownership

entries.decision: Codex is implementation collaborator; ChatGPT creates planning, designs and technical specifications
entries.notes: No gameplay code requested yet

entries.decision: Starter names Glintle, Driftfin, Brumlet map to WS-004, WS-008, WS-050
entries.notes: Owner to approve names and biology

entries.decision: Nine initial playable species + 18 moves; affinity cycle Flora/Tide/Ember
entries.notes: Numbers and wild names to playtest and approve

entries.decision: Trust-based creature invitation with observe + assist + friendly spar, deterministic threshold
entries.notes: Alternative classic battle/capture method still to decide

entries.decision: Release model free-to-play with cosmetics only
entries.notes: Premium/premium demo possible; revenue assumptions unvalidated

entries.decision: Commercial 1.0 targets 6 zones, 18–24 species, 3–5h story, 2-player co-op
entries.notes: Requires budget/feasibility owner signoff; multiplayer still intended

entries.decision: Separate offline-local and online server-trusted creature progression with cosmetic guest projection
entries.notes: Emotional continuity and security trade-off not approved

entries.decision: Party of 3, 4 moves per creature, 0-8 Signal Energy
entries.notes: Battle balance proof needed

entries.decision: Zone world graph: Lantern Quay, Mosswake Path, Liltwood, Echo Hollow + later Tideglass/Ashbell etc
entries.notes: Names, exact full geography and level scale draft

entries.decision: Four 48x32 zone maps as blockouts with Q001–Q005 scripted prologue
entries.notes: They are *not* final art-ready maps

entries.decision: Native C++20, SDL3, CMake, Gradle/NDK Android bridge
entries.notes: Benchmark/build before codebase commitment

entries.decision: Renderer selection between R1 grid raycast, R2 sector portal, R3 tiny software raster
entries.notes: Requires real Windows/Android visual/performance bakeoff

entries.decision: Minimum devices/OS and 2GB RAM compatibility claims
entries.notes: Real physical devices and repeatable benchmarks required

entries.decision: Store release monetization integration and entitlements
entries.notes: Need pricing decision, backend receipt verification, current store policies

entries.decision: 26 UI screens in design catalog with sharp UI separate from low-res world and two input schemes
entries.notes: Do not build all screens in first vertical slice

entries.decision: 1.0 online scope two-person co-op + hub; trading/ranked PvP afterwards
entries.notes: User wants multiplayer, feature phasing requires approval

entries.decision: Public branding/trademark store checks for title WILDSIGNAL
entries.notes: Search and legal clearance before launch/merchandise

entries.decision: Pin source asset archive and keep pixel-editable originals separate from public code
entries.notes: Need actual masters and explicit public repo source-sharing decision

entries.decision: 30fps minimum benchmark target and ~250MiB scene budget on target devices
entries.notes: Measurement goals, not verified performance claims
